{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes GETBLOCKTXN message processing in src/net_processing.cpp to address block I/O error handling during peer requests.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents an ungraceful assertion crash in net_processing during GETBLOCKTXN handling when block files fail to read. While resolving a peer message processing crash is worthwhile, I/O failures during block serving are an uncommon operational edge case."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "New test utilities and functional tests specifically exercise validation and P2P disk failure paths rather than general test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests that pin the behavior of block storage and P2P failure handling belong to their respective functional areas, not test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and alters block file access error paths in src/flatfile.cpp that impact ActivateBestChain and block storage.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents block storage I/O exceptions from bypassing FatalError during ActivateBestChain and leaving the node silently stuck. Ensuring proper fatal shutdown rather than an unresponsive, broken state preserves node integrity and operator visibility during disk failures."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
